title: San Francisco nursing homes that filed related-company statements
question: Which San Francisco nursing homes told the State they deal with a related company, and which companies?
finding: 10 San Francisco nursing homes filed related-company statements with their 2020 reports. 4 named two or more related companies. 5 name a company that matches a chain in the federal chain file: Aspen Skilled Healthcare (35 homes nationwide, $732,404 in federal fines); PACS Group (275 homes nationwide, $8.9 million in federal fines).
how: The San Francisco rows of the State list, one per home, with every related company it named, the one of them that serves the most homes statewide, and the same federal chain and Medicare-ownership name matches as the previous screen.
limits: Buying services, supplies or the use of a building from a company under the same ownership has to be disclosed. The State collects the related company’s profit-and-loss statement with the home’s yearly report and publishes which homes filed one; a State fact sheet adds that from fiscal years ending December 31, 2023 operators must also file combined accounts covering related companies that share 5% or more common ownership and serve the home. This list says who disclosed such dealings, not that anything was wrong. Only 2020 report periods are covered and no amounts are given. A chain’s fines are national totals and say nothing about the San Francisco home listed.
